name: rea-mcp-setup
summary: Register the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server with Claude Code using npx setup scripts.
steps: Ensure Node.js 22.19+ and npm are installed on system.
Run terminal command 'npx rea-agents setup' to initialize tools.
Register REA MCP server endpoints inside Claude Code config.json file.
jarvis_use: Connect REA MCP tools to Jarvis so the agent can inspect external websites and Mac software binaries.

name: webgl-app-structure-extraction
summary: Capture dynamic WebGL DOM elements, JavaScript script imports, and scroll hooks via automated browser sessions.
steps: Launch target URL in automated clean browser session.
Track DOM element depth, JS script bundles, and CSS libraries.
Detect rendering frameworks such as Three.js r165 and GSAP 3.12.5.
Log virtual scroll progress hooks and animation state mapping.
jarvis_use: Enable Jarvis to inspect dynamic interactive WebGL websites and detail their client-side architecture.

name: teardown-report-graph-ingestion
summary: Automatically save structured Markdown teardown reports directly into a local 3D knowledge graph vault.
steps: Compile captured structural metadata into a Markdown teardown report.
Transmit teardown file to local knowledge graph backend at localhost:4719.
Render target node in 3D force-directed second brain UI.
jarvis_use: Persist application architecture teardowns into Jarvis's permanent visual knowledge base.

name: clean-room-design-protocol
summary: Reconstruct software functional replacements using reverse-engineered structural blueprints without direct code copying.
steps: Extract high-level architectural specs, dependency maps, and layout blueprints from target application.
Provide structural blueprint to an isolated coding agent as a spec prompt.
Prohibit direct copy-pasting of original proprietary source code or graphic assets.
Generate original implementation codebase from scratch based purely on functional specs.
jarvis_use: Ensure Jarvis operates legally and ethically when rebuilding utility apps from reverse-engineered blueprints.

name: macos-appkit-binary-inspection
summary: Inspect macOS application bundles (.app) to extract Info.plist settings, Objective-C/Swift class symbols, compiled nib layouts, and XPC extensions.
steps: Locate target macOS application bundle path (e.g., /System/Applications/Notes.app).
Parse Info.plist for app version, build identifiers, and binary type.
Inspect compiled nib files, dylibs, and class symbols (e.g., ICM prefixed classes).
Enumerate auxiliary XPC plugin extensions for Siri, Spotlight, and Widgets.
jarvis_use: Allow Jarvis to analyze installed native Mac desktop software and uncover internal system dependencies.

name: voice-synthesized-teardown-reading
summary: Summarize and read aloud technical teardown findings section by section via voice output.
steps: Extract key architecture highlights from generated Markdown teardown report.
Pass summary text to text-to-speech audio rendering engine.
Play synthesized voice readout while updating agent HUD visual cards.
jarvis_use: Provide hands-free audio summaries of reverse-engineered software directly to the user.

name: teardown-blueprint-to-app-generation
summary: Use an REA teardown Markdown report as a spec prompt for Claude Code to scaffold and deploy a web application replacement.
steps: Feed REA teardown report as input blueprint into Claude Code CLI.
Instruct agent to build clean web implementation matching layout and functionality.
Scaffold multi-pane layout, markdown editing, task checklists, and local storage.
Deploy compiled web application into local sandboxed browser environment.
jarvis_use: Automate the end-to-end creation of web replacements for native Mac desktop applications.

name: side-by-side-app-verification
summary: Perform interactive comparative testing between a generated web app and the original native application.
steps: Arrange native application and newly generated web app side-by-side on screen.
Test UI keybindings (e.g. Cmd+N, Cmd+K, Cmd+P) across both environments.
Verify data persistence in browser local storage against expected behavior.
Confirm layout parity across multi-pane folder, list, and editor views.
jarvis_use: Validate that newly built web apps faithfully reproduce core user experience features of native apps.

name: 3d-knowledge-graph-agent-hud
summary: Control local AI agents via a web HUD running at localhost:4719 with a 3D force-directed visual graph.
steps: Host local dashboard server at localhost:4719.
Render active knowledge graph nodes using a 3D WebGL force-directed layout.
Display agent model status indicators and live execution cards (e.g. build/teardown state).
Listen for voice prompts via browser speech recognition.
jarvis_use: Provide a real-time visual interface for monitoring Jarvis's active reasoning and memory graph.

name: jarvis-system-prompt-pack-setup
summary: Configure multi-prompt agent system packs with Anthropic API credentials for voice and task execution.
steps: Load system prompt packs ('The Galaxy and the Brain', 'Speech', 'The Demo Moment').
Configure Anthropic API keys within configuration environment.
Bind system prompts to Claude Code agent session.
jarvis_use: Equip Jarvis with structured prompt pipelines tailored for voice interaction and multi-step agent reasoning.
